title: We’re building Olorun to make prediction-market accounts easier to understand
author: Hot_Chemistry_2600
selftext:
Prediction markets move fast, but understanding your account shouldn’t be complicated.  
  
We’re building Olorun to give users a clear view of their account, positions, performance, connections, and activity.  
  
Here’s the first coming-soon preview: [https://olorun.bet](https://olorun.bet)  
  
What information would you want to see first when opening a prediction-market dashboard?
